name: Muslim Daily Server
description: Backend API service for Muslim Daily providing prayer times, Quran, Hadith, Duas, Asmaul Husna (99 Names of Allah), Trilingual Dictionary and Translation service (Arabic, Amharic, and English), calendar features, and Fusha Qamus Quranic Lexicon (/qamus) with interactive developer documentation (/docs), UI workbench (/ui), and Swagger playground (/swagger).
